title: Orchestra played 'Anak' as Marcos entered APEC gala dinner venue in China
summary: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos walked into the venue of the APEC gala dinner in Shenzhen on Wednesday night with the orchestra playing an instrumental…

blocks.text: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos walked into the venue of the APEC gala dinner in Shenzhen on Wednesday night with the orchestra playing an instrumental version of Freddie Aguilar's "Anak," according to Ivan Mayrina's report on "24 Oras."
Anak, or child in Tagalog, is about a child who has gone astray and caused pain to the parents, after they lovingly took care of him.
The Palace has yet to comment on the matter.
Marcos was all smiles when he met with Chinese President Xi Jinping, being able to shake hands with him.
Xi welcomed leaders from all around the world as well during the APEC dinner.
Tensions between China and the Philippines have flared during the Marcos administration after the Philippine government reinforced its claim over the West Philippine Sea.
Former president Rodrigo Duterte showed a more lax stance when it came to the West Philippine Sea, showing a friendlier disposition with China despite concerns on maritime sovereignty.
Beijing has claimed most of the flashpoint waters despite the Permanent Court of Arbitration ruling in the Philippines’ favor in 2016. —Jean Mangaluz/NB, GMA News
